newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basic Petroleum, Pryce sign joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Basic Petroleum, Pryce sign joint venture.

text.p: Basic Petroleum and Minerals Inc said on Thursday it forged a memorandum of agreement with the parent of Pryce Properties Corp for the development of property in the southern island of Mindanao.

Under the agreement, Basic Petroleum and Pryce Development Corp, or their respective subsidiaries, will form a joint venture to undertake real estate projects, the oil exploration firm said in a statement.
The proposed joint venture will have an authorised capital of one billion pesos, of which 600 million pesos will be initially subscribed and paid-up.
Pryce will initially pay 400 million pesos while Basic Petroleum will pay 200 million pesos, with option to increase its equity to 400 million pesos, the statement said.
